Mr. Quo Tai Chi files law suit against members of the National
Salvation Federation

The case which Mr. Quo Tai Chi filed against certain persons
who are members of the National Salvation Federation and associate
organizations, charging them with interference with the lawful
discharge of the public functions (Art. 142-148 of the C.C.)
(Vide I.R. 16/5/32) was brought before the 2nd Special District Court

furnish security of $200 each and the case was remanded sine die.
Four of them supplied cash securities while the other offered a
security furnished by the local Chinese Bar Association.

Mr. Quo Tai-chi files lawsuit against members of the
National Salvation Federation.

In connection with the visit of representatives of the
National Salvation Federation of Various Bodies at his
residence on May 3 and the subsequent assault on him by
some 20 students (Vide I.R.4/5/32), Mr. Quo Tai-chi has filed
a suit in the 2nd Special District Court against eight
persons who are members of the National Salvation Federation
and associate organizations, charging them with interference
with the lawful discharge of public functions (Art. 142-148
of the C.C.R.C.). Preliminary proceedings will take place
before the Procurator at 9 a.m. to-day, May 16 when it is
expected that three of the defendants who have been served
with summonses will appear.

At a meeting in their office, 89 Jen An Li, Kuling
Road, between 3.30 and 5 p.m. May 15, six committee
members of the National Salvation Federation of Various
Shanghai Bodies decided to engage four Chinese lawyers to
defend their representatives in the above case. Meanwhile
it was also resolved to convene a meeting of representatives
of various bodies in the federation office at 4 p.m. May
17 to discuss measures to be adopted towards the Court's
decision in the case.

May , 1932.

Eastern Times and other local newspapers:
Assault on Mr. Quo Tai Chi.

At 8 a.m. yesterday, four representatives of the
Various Public Bodies National Salvation Federation visited Mr.
Quo Tai Chi, Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs, at his residence
at No. 2 Rue Camille Loriot. They were received by Mr. Quo Tai Chi
in person who explained to them that the Japanese demand that no
Chinese troops be stationed in the district south of the Soochow
Creek and in Pootung has not been accepted, but that China has
agreed, for the time being, not to cause any transfers among the
soldiers stationed at these places. Mr. Quo promised to produce
for their information the agreement for the cessation of hostilities.

At about 8.30 a.m. representatives of the Federation
of citizens public bodies and of the University Students Anti-
Japanese and National Salvation Federation and call on Mr. Quo Tai
Chi and asked him to produce the draft agreement.

At about 9 a.m. another batch of about 20 persons rushed
into the drawing room where Mr. Quo was receiving the representative
Mr. Quo to the representatives the Chinese text of the agreement, but
the callers demanded to the English text as well. Mr. Quo consented
and while he was reading the first article, a certain representative
suddenly rushed forward, seized the document which Mr Quo was reading
and tore it into pieces. Some of the crowd then hurled coppers and tea
cups at Mr. Quo wounding him in the face.

The watchman, hearing the commotion, called up the French
Police, but when the police arrived most of the assailants had already
made good their escape but eleven persons were taken to the Police
Station, two of whom, Ying Tsz Ling and Lee Sz San, representatives
of the Various Public Bodies National Salvation Federation were
afterwards released at the request of Mr. Quo Tai Chi.

According to Mr. Quo Tai Chi, the Peace Conference will
not be postponed. After the occurance of the incident, the British,
American and Cuban Ministers and the Italian and Chilian Charges
d'Affairs called upon Mr. Quo Tai Chi to express their sympathy.

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：
袭击郭泰祺先生事件。

昨日上午8时，上海各界救国联合会的四名代表前往外交部次长郭泰祺先生位于卡米耶·洛里奥路（Rue Camille Loriot）2号的寓所拜访。郭泰祺先生亲自接见，并向他们解释称，日本方面要求不在苏州河以南地区及浦东驻扎中国军队的要求未被接受，但中国已同意暂时不调动驻守在这些地方的士兵。郭先生承诺将出示停战协定供他们查阅。

上午8时30分左右，市民公共团体联合会及大学生抗日救国联合会的代表拜访郭泰祺先生，并要求他出示协定草案。

上午9时左右，另一批约20人冲进郭先生正在接待代表的客厅。郭先生向代表们出示了协定的中文文本，但来访者要求同时也出示英文文本。郭先生表示同意，正当他阅读第一条时，某位代表突然冲上前，夺过郭先生正在阅读的文件并将其撕碎。随后人群中有人向郭先生投掷铜板和茶杯，致使其面部受伤。

巡捕听到骚动后呼叫了法租界巡捕房，但当巡捕赶到时，大多数袭击者已逃脱，但有十一人被带往警察局。其中两人，即上海各界救国联合会代表殷芝龄和李次山，后经郭泰祺先生请求获释。

据郭泰祺先生称，和平会议不会推迟。事件发生后，英国、美国和古巴公使以及意大利和智利代办拜访了郭泰祺先生以表达慰问。

May 6, 1932.

MISCELLANEOUS

China Times and other local newspapers

THE ASSAULT OF MR. QUO TAI CHI.

The National Salvation Federation of Various Shanghai Bodies yesterday issued the following important manifesto:-

"Since May 1 Chinese and foreign newspapers have repeatedly published astonishing reports to the effect that the Japanese delegates are insisting that Chinese troops must not be stationed in Pootung and Nantao. It is also reported that the Sub-Committee is also discussing the matter and that the British Minister to China is persuading the Chinese delegates to make concessions. Our Government and diplomatic delegates have not refuted these reports.

"In pursuance of a decision reached at a meeting of the Standing Committee on May 2, we sent a telegram to the Government voicing our opposition and simultaneously detailed Li Tse San and five other representatives to call at the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and to point out that all discussions of the demilitarization of Pootung and Nantao will be deeply resented by the people. As Mr. Quo Tai Chi was absent on that day, Messrs. Li Tse San, Ying Ts Ling, Zia Jung Ping, and Yang Yung Wei at 8 a.m. the following day called again at Mr. Quo Tai Chi's residence. As there was great doubt in the minds of the people, a number of them, during the interview between Mr. Quo and our representatives, invaded the room and following upon an altercation, Mr. Quo was unfortunately injured. The incident was absolutely unexpected and on the same day we sent a letter consoling Mr. Quo and requesting him to continue at his work".

The Federation of the People's Various Public Bodies yesterday sent out the following telegram:-

"In a previous telegram sent out by us, we protested against the conclusion of any agreement humiliating to China. However, the text of the newly concluded agreement and the three annexes show that the rights of our country are being impaired. The terms are humiliating and unreasonable. One of the annexes provides that the Chinese armies are to be stationed from Foh San on the Yangtsze River to Heilee, Taichong, Anting, Ben Hyeh Kong. When in Chinese territory the Chinese armies may move about without any restriction. The text is cunningly worded. As our territorial integrity is impaired, the agreement is contrary to the resolutions of the 19 Committeemen of the League of Nations.

"The Third annex provides that the Japanese army must not use the eastern bank of the Whangpu River, which includes the Shanghai-Wocsung Railway, the Tung Chi Medical and Engineering College, the Central University, the Medical College and the China College, as well as Chang Hwa Pang and Jen Tsao Pang. 《时事新报》及其他本地报纸

袭击郭泰祺先生事件。

上海各界救国联合会昨日发布如下重要宣言：-

“自5月1日以来，中外报纸反复刊登令人震惊的报道，称日本代表坚持要求不得在浦东和南市驻扎中国军队。另有报道说，小组委员会也在讨论此事，且英国驻华公使正在劝说中国代表做出让步。我国政府及外交代表并未驳斥这些报道。

“根据5月2日常务委员会会议作出的决定，我们向政府发出电报表示反对，同时派遣李次山等五名代表前往外交部上海办事处，指出关于浦东和南市非军事化的所有讨论将引起民众的强烈不满。由于郭泰祺先生当日不在，李次山、殷芝龄、夏荣平（音译）和杨永维四位先生于次日上午8时再次前往郭泰祺先生寓所。由于民众心中存有极大疑虑，在郭先生与我们代表会谈期间，一些人闯入房间，发生争执后，郭先生不幸受伤。此事件完全出乎意料，同日我们致信慰问郭先生，并请他继续工作”。

人民各公共团体联合会昨日发出如下电报：-

“在我们此前发出的电报中，我们抗议缔结任何有辱中国的协定。然而，新近缔结的协定正文及三个附件显示，我国权利正受到损害。条款具有侮辱性且不合理。其中一个附件规定，中国军队可驻扎在从长江上的佛山（音译）到海伦（音译）、太仓、安亭、本耶孔（音译）一线。在中国领土内，中国军队可以自由移动，不受任何限制。行文措辞狡诈。由于我国领土完整受到损害，该协定违背了国际联盟十九国委员会的决议。

“第三附件规定，日军不得使用黄浦江东岸，其中包括沪淞铁路、同济医工专门学校、中央大学、医学院以及中华学院，还有张华浜和蕴藻浜。这看起来似乎是日本作为

special favour to China and that China has pitifully

郭泰祺先生遇袭案。

今日上午8时30分，中国律师公会代表李次山（Li Se Shan）、大学教授代表谢承平（Zia Sen Bing）、大学生代表沈佐仕（Seng So Ze）、留日归国学生协会代表杨永威（Yang Yong Wai）以及救国会代表殷芝龄（Ying Tse Ling），前往罗利兹路（Rue Lorioz）2号郭泰祺先生寓所，要求他就5月1日、2日和3日中外报纸刊登的关于中国政府已接受日本提出的禁止在浦东和南市驻扎中国军队之提议的新闻作出解释，并请求郭先生不要签署包含此项禁令的任何协定。
郭先生于上午9时30分会见了他们，并声明他不会签署任何有辱国格的协定。

谈话至此阶段，约二十名青年学生闯入房间，高呼“打倒郭泰祺”。
其中一名闯入者随即抓起一只茶杯砸向郭先生面部，其他人则向他头部投掷成把的铜元。茶杯造成这位副部长眉骨上方一处割伤。袭击者随后企图逃窜。

REPORT NO. 94/S.

Assault of Mr. Quo Tai Chi.

At 8.30 this morning, Li Se Shan, representative
of the Chinese Bar Association, Zia Sen Bing, Representative
of the Professors of Universities, Seng So Ze, representative
of University Students, Yang Yong Wai, representative of
Chinese Returned Students from Japan, and Ying Tse Ling,
representative of the Association to Relieve the National
Crisis, called at the residence of Mr. Quo Tai Chi, No. 2
Rue Lorioz, to ask him for an explanation of the news published
in foreign and Chinese newspapers on May 1, May 2nd and May 3rd
to the effect that the Chinese Authorities have accepted the
Japanese proposals regarding the prohibition to station
Chinese troops at Pootung and Nantao, and to request Mr. Quo
not to sign any agreement containing this prohibition.
They were received at 9.30 a.m. by Mr. Quo who declared that
he will not sign any agreement humiliating to the country.

At this stage in the conversation, about twenty
young students entered the room shouting "Down with Quo Tai Chi".
One of the intruders then seized a cup and threw it into the
face of Mr. Quo while others hurled handfuls of coppers at
his head. The cup caused a cut just above the eyebrow of
the Vice Minister. The assailants then attempted to take
to flight.

In the meantime Mr. Hsia Hsi Feng, a counsellor
of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, informed me by telephone
of what was taking place. The reserve brigade at Poste Foch
was sent to the scene. About 15 persons (see attached list)
were arrested and taken to the office of the Political
Department for interrogation.

THE ASSAULT ON MR. QUO TAI CHI

The following editorial is published to-day
over the initials "G. M." (Georges Moresthe, Editor):-

Among the persons who attacked Mr. Quo Tai Chi
were ten students and a lawyer named Li Se Chan, a member
of the Chinese Bar Association. The assailants took
the precaution of carrying out their attack with the
minimum of risk for they had the numerical strength of
2 to 1.

In a country like China where most of the
politicians shirk their responsibilities and many of
whom excused themselves when offered the difficult task
of negotiating with the Japanese, Mr. Quo, who is Vice Minister
of Foreign Affairs, may be regarded as a laudable
exception. He did not hesitate to accept the heavy
task which the Government gave him and he has carried
out his work with great firmness in the face of threats
from the agitators and the cries of the excited people
who further increases in proportion to their ignorance.

One would like to ask what the lawyer Li Se

could suggest to settle the Sino-Japanese conflict

Despite the defeat and withdrawal of the

to the defeated, which is in itself contrary to all
precedent. This is admittedly a success for Chinese
diplomacy and especially for Mr. Quo Tai Chi.

personal sacrifices they have made for the triumph of

今日发表以下社论，署名缩写为“G. M.”（乔治·莫雷斯特 Georges Moresthe，编辑）：-

袭击郭泰祺先生的人中有十名学生和一名名叫李次山（Li Se Chan）的律师，他是中国律师公会会员。袭击者采取了预防措施，以最小风险实施袭击，因为他们的人数优势为二比一。

在中国这样一个大多数政客逃避责任、许多人在被委以与日本人谈判这一艰巨任务时推脱的国家里，身为外交部次长的郭先生可被视为一个值得称赞的例外。他毫不犹豫地接受了政府赋予他的重任，并在面对煽动者的威胁和情绪激动的人群（其喧嚣程度随无知程度成正比增加）的呼喊时，以极大的坚定性履行了他的职责。

人们不禁要问，律师李次山和袭击郭先生的二十名左右学生，能提出什么建议来解决上海的日中冲突？

尽管中国军队战败并撤退，郭先生却为战败方争取到了有利的停战协定，这本身违背了所有先例。这无疑是中国外交的胜利，尤其是郭泰祺先生的胜利。

毫无疑问，律师和年轻学生们自认为有资格给郭先生上一堂爱国主义课，我们非常想知道他们为中国事业的胜利做出了什么个人牺牲

the Chinese cause. When one is young, the best way

Mr. Kuo has won a victory for China, he has

The true patriots in September last year

Mr. Wang Ching Wei, in the course of a

今日，《上海日报》以“G.M.”为署名发表了以下社论：

汪精卫先生在一份声明中，谴责了组织袭击郭泰祺先生的暴徒，并宣称这些煽动者打着爱国的幌子，策划旨在牟利的骚乱。至于国家最终将因他们的煽动而遭受苦难，他们则毫不在意。

正是以爱国的名义，上海抵制运动的领袖们犯下了种种不法行为，这些行为最终将战祸引至我们门口，导致闸北大部被毁，日军占领了从南翔经嘉定至浏河的地带。就在郭先生即将促成日军撤退之际，这些愚蠢的人却攻击了他，却没有意识到他们的犯罪行为可能导致日军长期占领。

迄今为止，中国当局对公共秩序的破坏者表现出了令人痛心的软弱。汪精卫先生提到，煽动者寻求外国租界作为庇护所，以策划其阴谋。然而，外国当局在处理这些人方面一直恪尽职守，但中国法院另一方面却极为宽纵。这使得当局的工作变得非常困难。

    Nevertheless, the Nanking Government
yesterday issued strict orders for the punishment
of the persons responsible and the prosecution of the
illegal bodies. In our opinion, it would be better
to draw the attention of the Chinese judges to the
intolerable scandal which has been created by their
decisions in cases affecting agitators or persons
in their pay. -In this connection, we have to draw
attention to the inexcusable leniency shown on May 3,
by a judge of the District Court in the French Concession
towards an individual who took part in an attack against
a peaceful Japanese merchant and whose guilt was
recognized by the Court. It would appear that on
March 31 several members of a boycott organ attacked
a Japanese pedestrian on Avenue Edward VII and
seriously injured him. One of the assailants named
Feng Ah Dou, 30, unemployed, was arrested by the French
Police. After several remands of one week each, the
District Court in the French Concession eventually
delivered judgment on May. 3: the Judge, Mr. Wang,
being unable to discharge the accused without violating
the law, sentenced the man to three months imprisonment
with suspension of sentence. When we recollect the
severity of Chinese Judges towards minor offences, one
is compelled to say that Judge Wang's decision is
tainted with prejudice.

bow down before the agitators, the most rigorous
instructions for the repression of the illegal
activities of these creators of trouble will be
without effect.

REPORT NO. 94/S.

Assault on Mr. Quo Tai Chi.

At 8.30 this morning, Li Se Shan, representative
of the Chinese Bar Association, Zia Sen Bing, representative
of the Professors of the Universities, Seng So Ze, representative
of University Students, Yang Yong Wai, representative of
Chinese Returned Students from Japan, and Ying Tse Ling,
representative of the Association to Relieve the National
Crisis, called at the residence of Mr. Quo Tai Chi, No. 2
Rue Lorioz, to ask him for explanation of the news published
in foreign and Chinese newspapers on May 1, May 2 and May 3
to the effect that the Chinese authorities have accepted the
Japanese proposals regarding the prohibition of station
Chinese troops at Pootung and Nantao, and to request Mr. Quo
not to sign any agreement containing this prohibition.
They were received at 9.30 a.m. by Mr. Quo who declared that
he will not sign any agreement humiliating to the country.

At this stage in the conversation, about twenty
young students entered the room shouting "Down with Quo Tai Chi".
One of the intruders then seized a cup and threw it into the
face of Mr. Quo while others hurled handfuls of coppers at
his head. The cup caused a cut just above the eyebrow of
the Vice Minister. The assailants then attempted to take
to flight.

In the meantime Mr. Hsia Hsi Feng, a counsellor
of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, informed me by telephone
of what was taking place. The reserve brigade at Poste Foch
was sent to the scene. About 15 persons (see attached list)
were arrested and taken to the office of the Political
Department for interrogation.

袭击郭泰祺先生案。

今天上午8时30分，中国律师协会代表李次山（Li Se Shan，音译）、大学教授代表谢曾炳（Zia Sen Bing，音译）、大学生代表沈佐修（Seng So Ze，音译）、留日归国学生协会代表杨永威（Yang Yong Wai，音译）以及救国协会代表殷芝龄（Ying Tse Ling，音译），前往劳利兹路（Rue Lorioz）2号郭泰祺先生寓所，就5月1日、2日和3日中外报纸刊登的关于中国当局已接受日本方面关于禁止在浦东和南市驻扎中国军队的提议的新闻，向他要求解释，并请求郭先生不要签署包含此项禁令的任何协议。上午9时30分，郭先生接见了他们，并表示他不会签署任何有辱国家的协议。

谈话至此阶段，约二十名年轻学生闯入房间，高呼“打倒郭泰祺”。随后，一名闯入者抓起一只茶杯掷向郭先生面部，其他人则向他头部投掷大把铜板。茶杯造成这位副部长眉骨上方一处割伤。袭击者随即试图逃窜。

与此同时，外交部顾问夏希丰（Hsia Hsi Feng，音译）通过电话向我通报了正在发生的情况。福煦路捕房（Poste Foch）的后备队被派往现场。约15人（见附名单）被捕，并被带至政治部办公室接受审讯。

I then proceeded to Mr. Quo Tai Chi's residence
where I saw General Gaston Wang and Mr. Hsia Hai Peng. After
consulting Mr. Quo Tai Chi, these two gentlemen asked me not
to charge the persons arrested before the Chinese Court but to
detain them until tomorrow. They will deal with Li Tse Sai,
representative of the Chinese Bar Association, and Ying Tae Ling,
representative of the Association to Relieve the National Crisis
(both of whom are not to be detained) in the following manner:-

1) The representatives concerned will tender an
apology to Mr. Quo Tai Chi in the Chinese Press in which they
will express disapproval of the action of an ignorant and
excited comrade. They will add that having learned from
Mr. Quo Tai Chi himself that the draft agreement with the
Japanese does not contain any clause humiliating to China they
have confidence in the Minister and advise the Chinese people
of Shanghai to do likewise.

2) The Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs will
request the French Police not to bring the affair into the
Court.

The Police will say that after an investigation
had been made none of the arrested persons have been recognized
by the witnesses (which is true) and that in consequence there
will be no prosecution.

- 2 -

随后我前往郭泰祺先生寓所，在那里见到了王加斯顿将军（General Gaston Wang，音译）和夏海鹏（Hsia Hai Peng，音译）先生。在与郭泰祺先生商议后，这两位先生要求我不要将被捕人员移送中国法院起诉，而是将他们拘留至明日。他们将按以下方式处理中国律师协会代表李次山（Li Tse Sai，音译）和救国协会代表殷泰龄（Ying Tae Ling，音译）（两人均不予拘留）事宜：-

1) 有关代表将在中文报刊上向郭泰祺先生道歉，表示不赞成某位无知且激动的同伴的行为。他们还将补充说，既然从郭泰祺先生本人处得知，与日本的协议草案中不包含任何有辱中国的条款，他们对部长充满信心，并建议上海中国民众也这样做。

2) 外交部次长将请求法国警察不将此案提交法庭。

警方将称，经调查，证人未认出任何被捕人员（此属实），因此不予起诉。

COMPTE - RENDU N° 94/S

Object : Voies de faits sur la personne de M. QUO-TAI-CHI

Ce matin à 8 h.30, M.M. LI-FU-SHAN, représentant de l'Associa-
tion des avocats, SIA-FENG-BING, représentant des professeurs des
universités, SENG-SO-ZE, représentant des étudiants des universités,
YING-YONG-WAI, représentant des étudiants chinois retour du Japon et
YING-TSE-LING, représentant de l'Association pour surmonter les dif-
ficultés nationales, se sont rendus chez M. QUO-TAI-CHI, 2, Rue
Lorioz, pour lui demander des explications sur les nouvelles publiées
les 1er, 2 et 3 Mai par les journaux chinois et étrangers, disant que
les Autorités Chinoises auraient accepté les propositions des Autori-
tés Japonaises, au sujet de l'interdiction pour les troupes chinoi-
ses de cantonner à Pootung et à Nantao et pour demander à Mr. QUO,
de ne pas signer d'accord dans ce sens. Ils furent reçus à 9 h.30
par M. QUO qui leur déclara qu'il ne signerait aucun accord outra-
geant pour le pays.

A ce moment de la conversation, une vingtaine de jeunes gens -
des étudiants - pénétrèrent dans le salon où se tenaient M. QUO et
ses visiteurs et se mirent à crier :"Abattre QUO-TAI-CHI". L'un de
ces individus s'empara alors d'une tasse et la lança à la figure de
M. QUO, d'autres lui lancèrent des poignées de coppers, à la tête.
La tasse vint se briser sur le front du vice-Ministre le blessant
légèrement au dessus de l'arcade sourcilière; après quoi, les
agresseurs s'empressèrent de prendre la fuite.

第 94/S 号报告

事由：对郭泰祺先生的人身攻击

今晨8时30分，律师协会代表李福山（LI-FU-SHAN，音译）、大学教授代表谢凤炳（SIA-FENG-BING，音译）、大学生代表沈索泽（SENG-SO-ZE，音译）、留日归国中国学生代表杨永威（YING-YONG-WAI，音译）以及克服国难协会代表殷芝龄（YING-TSE-LING），前往劳利兹路2号郭泰祺先生处，就5月1日、2日和3日中外报纸刊登的新闻向他要求解释，该新闻称中国当局已接受日本当局关于禁止中国军队驻扎浦东和南市的提议，并要求郭先生不要签署此类协议。上午9时30分，郭先生接见了他们，并向他们声明他不会签署任何有辱国家的协议。

谈话至此时刻，约二十名年轻人——学生——闯入郭先生与其访客所在的客厅，开始高喊：“打倒郭泰祺”。其中一人随即抓起一只茶杯掷向郭先生面部，其他人则向他头部投掷大把铜板。茶杯在副部长前额破碎，使其眉弓上方受轻伤；随后，袭击者急忙逃窜。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Entre temps, M. HSIA-HSI-FENG, conseiller du Waichiaopou, m'
ayant prévenu par téléphone de ce qui venait de se passer, la briga-
de de réserve du Poste Fosh fut envoyée sur les lieux. Une quinzaine
de personnes (voir liste ci-jointe) furent arrêtées et conduites au
Bureau du Service Politique pour interrogatoire.

A la suite de cette affaire, je me rendis chez M. QUO-TAI-CHI,
où je vis le Général Gaston WANG et M. HSIA-SHI-FENG. Ceux-ci, après
avoir conféré avec M. QUO-TAI-CHI, me demandèrent de ne pas poursui-
vre devant la Cour Chinoise les personnes arrêtées, mais de les gar-
der dans nos locaux, jusqu'à demain, à l'exception de M. LI-TSE-SAI,
représentant de l'association des avocats et de M. YING-TSE-LING,
représentant de l'Association pour surmonter les difficultés natio-
nales, avec qui M. HSIA-SHI-FENG va essayer de régler l'incident
comme suit :

1° Les représentants intéressés feront des excuses à M.QUO-TAI-
CHI, par la voie de la presse et diront qu'ils désapprouvent le geste
d'un camarade ignorant et exalté. Ils ajouteront qu'ayant appris
de la bouche même de M. QUO-TAI-CHI que le projet d'accord avec les
Japonais ne contient aucune clause humiliante pour la Chine, ils
font confiance au Ministre et conseillent à la population chinoise
de Shanghai de les suivre dans cette voie.

2° Le vice-Ministre du Waichiaopou demandera en échange à la
Police Française de ne pas présenter l'affaire devant la cour.

（批：Mal fait / pas satisfaisant）

- 2 -

其间，外交部顾问夏希丰（HSIA-HSI-FENG，音译）通过电话通知我刚才发生的情况，福煦路捕房（Poste Fosh）的后备队被派往现场。约十五人（见附名单）被捕，并被带至政治科办公室接受审讯。

此事发生后，我前往郭泰祺先生寓所，在那里见到了王加斯顿将军（Gaston WANG）和夏世丰（HSIA-SHI-FENG，音译）先生。他们在与郭泰祺先生商议后，要求我不将被捕人员移送中国法院起诉，而是将他们关押在我方场所直至明日，但中国律师协会代表李次山（LI-TSE-SAI，音译）和克服国难协会代表殷芝龄（YING-TSE-LING）除外，夏世丰先生将尝试按以下方式与此二人解决此事：

1° 有关代表将通过新闻界向郭泰祺先生道歉，并称他们不赞成某位无知且激动的同伴的举动。他们还将补充说，既然从郭泰祺先生亲口得知，与日本的协议草案中不包含任何有辱中国的条款，他们对部长充满信心，并建议上海中国民众效仿此举。

2° 作为交换，外交部次长将请求法国警察不将此案提交法庭。

（批注：做得不好 / 不令人满意）
